hook.h2: When the shepherds wore out, He took the flock into His own hands
hook.text: For the Sovereign Father says: I myself will search for my sheep and look after them.
father: I myself will search for my sheep and look after them.
hook.note: Ezekiel served in a season when Israel's shepherds had grown weary and the flock had scattered. Our Father did not answer with a harder charge or a better strategy — He answered by taking the flock back into His own hands, and He said it in the first person, over and over, through the whole chapter. Every pastor needs to see those four words in His color: I myself will.

short350: You have wanted a Father your whole life. Not a doctrine about Him. Not a distant power. A Father — His voice, His heart turned toward you.
Father's Heart Bible is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking.
Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's in RED. The Spirit's in PURPLE.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color marks ownership, not quotation: His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, words He never spoke are never colored, and narration stays black.

When Israel's shepherds had worn out and the flock had scattered, our Father did not send a harder charge. He said out loud, in the first person: "I myself will search for my sheep and look after them." The flock was His the whole time.
That is what this Bible was made to do. Not to tell you about a Father who speaks, but to show you where He already has.

He is not distant. He is not disappointed. He is your Heavenly Father, and He delights in you as His beloved child. If father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you: the Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood, but the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

An introduction opens each book, a Father's note closes each with a short prayer, and 1,354 notes serve the reader, not the scholar. A presentation page carries their name. Six by nine, hardcover, full color throughout.
A fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek — complete, 66 books and 31,085 verses. A gift, a keepsake, an heirloom.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

faq.q: What makes the Pastor's Bible different from the other editions?
faq.a: It is the complete Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color — the same translation, the same 876 pages, the same 1,354 study notes as every other edition. What is made for a pastor is the cover and the pages that open the book: a word written for this reader, and passages on intimacy, identity, and inheritance chosen for where they are. We would rather tell you that plainly than claim notes or prayers that are not in it.

faq.q: Is this the whole Bible, or a selection?
faq.a: The whole Bible. 66 books, 1,189 chapters, 31,085 verses, Genesis to Revelation, nothing abridged — 876 pages of it, in full color throughout.

For a hundred and twenty-five years red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and until now those words were printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color marks ownership, not quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

faq.q: Can I read it before I buy a copy?
faq.a: Yes, all of it. Every word of the Father's Heart Bible™ is free to read at fathersheartbible.com/read, in twenty-five languages, with the color on the page exactly as it is in print. English and Telugu can also be listened to. Nobody has to buy anything to receive our Father's voice.

faq.q: Can I preach and quote from the Father's Heart Bible™?
faq.a: Yes. Up to 500 verses may be quoted in any form — written, visual, electronic or audio — without written permission, provided the quotations are not more than 25% of the work and no complete book of the Bible is quoted. In non-salable media such as bulletins, orders of service and projected slides, no full copyright notice is required; the initials FHB at the end of each quotation are enough. Larger use, or a commercial commentary built on the text, needs written permission from publisher@spiritmediapublishing.com.

It is the complete Bible, and what a pastor receives here first is our Father's own voice on the page — 125,457 words of it, in BLUE, where until now it was printed like the genealogies. The 1,354 notes serve the reader rather than the scholar: 1,075 explain a word, name, custom or background, 248 mark where the text reveals the Father, and 31 record a difference among the manuscripts.

faq.q: Can we order copies for our elders, staff or whole church?
faq.a: Yes — order direct and the volume discount runs from 10% at ten copies to 30% at 250, and you can mix editions freely across all sixteen: the Pastor's Bible for your staff, the Teen Bible for the youth group, the Recovery Bible for a ministry that needs it. Shipping is free at any quantity. For 500 or more, contact us directly.
